headline: Approved conditional plans for a casino expansion, a gas station at 1265 South Willow Street, and a dog hotel at 800 Gold Street.
summary: Approval of the casino expansion depends on a third-party review of its traffic study. Also approved were a four-unit conversion at 883 Union Street and a six-unit conversion at 308 Lake Avenue. A mid-rise building with 167 dwelling units at 88 Pine Street was continued to December.
decisions: Approved waivers from driveway width rules for the SP2026-010 site.
Conditionally approved the site plan SP2026-010 for Phases 2 and 3 of the gaming facility project.
Approved lot line adjustment S2026-011 between 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive.
Approved reduced on-site parking at 1265 South Willow Street under CU2026-005.
Approved a waiver letting the light pole base at 1265 South Willow Street be taller than the regulations require.
Approved site plan SP2026-011 for a new fueling station and drive-through restaurant at 1265 South Willow Street.
Continued CU2026-010 for 60 days, to the December business meeting.
Approved waivers from landscape, grading, lighting, signage, and refuse rules for 883 Union Street.
Approved site plan SP2026-018 for a four-unit home at 883 Union Street, with an amended parking condition.
Approved waivers from landscape plan, outdoor lighting, signage, and refuse rules at 308 Lake Avenue.
Approved site plan SP2026-016 to convert a two-unit building into six residential units at 308 Lake Avenue.
Approved conditional use permit CU2026-008 for an animal boarding facility at 800 Gold Street, contingent on two other approvals.
Approved reduced parking, with 13 spaces, for the dog facility at 800 Gold Street, subject to SP2026-017.
Approved site plan SP2026-017 to redevelop 800 Gold Street as a dog hotel and daycare.
Approved finding that S2026-017, CU2026-013, and SP2026-020 do not have regional impact, with one abstention.
Approved the September 17, 2026 minutes as written, with two abstentions.
